verdict.rationale: Pigment documents an HR & workforce use case that offers one-click scenario modeling (pigment-docs-11), so workforce planning is a first-party capability. Generic native connectors and scheduled imports (pigment-docs-7) suggest actuals could be loaded, but no source ties them to payroll. Missing for 10: role-level headcount planning, payroll actuals integration, planned hires flowing into the expense forecast, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
